source_title: Pregnancy and Neonatal Outcomes After Fetal Exposure to Biologics and Thiopurines Among Women With Inflammatory Bowel Disease
known_source_inconsistencies: Table 4 lists natalizumab n=4 but the infant concentration >10 micrograms/mL row displays 9/22 (41%), which is internally impossible for that column. The generated atoms do not use this field.
Main Table 4 reports n=235 for serum drug concentrations, while supplemental serum tables use n=234. The difference is preserved rather than reconciled.
Main Methods says follow-up levels were collected when drug was detectable at birth; the supplemental plan specifies repeat levels only when the infant level exceeded 2 micrograms/mL.

repair_attempt.reason: Added explicit source page 1135 marker for Main Table 2 to satisfy the central-results QA check.

warnings: No external clinical-practice verification was performed; SEA-QA checks source fidelity, coverage, and HTML mechanics rather than current guideline alignment.
